pages.text: Stand right next to the controller and right-click it (not sneaking) to take the controls; right-click again to let go. Your keys now drive the engine:

$(li)$(item)Start Engine$() (default $(item)I$()): starts or stops the engine. It starts at idle, about a quarter of full power.$(li)$(item)Forward$(): throttle. Held, it raises power step by step up to full. Released, the engine falls back to idle.$(li)$(item)Back$(): brake, back to idle quickly.

$(li)$(item)Shift Up$() / $(item)Shift Down$() (default $(item)V$() / $(item)C$()): change gear.$(li)$(item)Left$(), $(item)Right$() and the $(item)Custom Button$() (default $(item)B$()): send the redstone link frequencies set in the controller menu while held.

$(l)Gears$()$(br)Reverse, Neutral, then gears 1 to 6. On an engine with a shaft at $(item)both ends$(), the gear scales the output: reverse 30% backwards, neutral 0, gears 1 to 6 give 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 and 120%.$(br2)The keys can be changed in the Controls menu.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
